comparison.objective: Clamp a printed part upright in a vise at a marked height.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand holds part pose while the other rotates the vise control to generate clamping force.
comparison.success_condition: Part is tightly clamped upright with its mark aligned to the jaw tops.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual tool/fixture operations, but vise closure tests sustained rotary tightening while holding a workpiece. The candidate tests impulse transfer through a coaxial mandrel, fracture without coil displacement, and fragment retrieval.
